title: Working fullscreen and live entity detail tables
changes: The network explorer now enters true fullscreen using a supported container.
Hover over a node for its published properties and relationships; click or select to keep it open.
Entity details load on demand and reuse the browser cache.

title: Space covers as app icons
changes: Spaces without an avatar now use their Geo cover image, cropped into a beveled square.
The same icon treatment appears on app cards, workspace icons and featured-space buttons.

title: Space-aware app icons and shareable graph views
changes: App icons follow the leading space in their loaded data, using its live Geo avatar.
People and Research debates open with an initial education graph.
Share links to a chosen space and a focus node in the loaded network.

title: More resilient graph discovery
changes: AI and World affairs now resolve unnamed author identities through their Geo profile pages.
An unnamed entity no longer prevents its whole network from rendering.
Graph exports preserve the original identities and record where resolved labels came from.

title: A full-window interactive network explorer
changes: Explore animated directional networks in a canvas-first applet with compact controls.
Highlight neighbors by hovering, tapping or selecting a node; show Geo avatars where available.
Keep filters and exports in a drawer, with pause, image and reduced-motion controls.

title: Clearer preference controls
changes: Choose text size and image loading with clearly grouped options.
Turn the force-graph explorer on or off with a labeled switch.

title: Consistent graph layouts and featured spaces
changes: Keep graph app headers, headings and controls consistent with the rest of Companion.
Explore pinned spaces discovered from Geo’s Featured tag in both graph apps.

title: Explore people and research relationships
changes: New People & Contributions and Research Debates apps with readable, focused relationship diagrams.
Enable the optional force-graph explorer in Preferences for fullscreen exploration, pinning and layout controls.
Filter and export visible relationships as JSON or CSV, or save a force-graph image.

title: More useful live study and outreach data
changes: Read published outreach hours in the weekly schedule, with provider confirmation links.
Inspect additional reported education estimates with their units, estimands and p-values.

title: Clearer map popups
changes: Map selections now use readable, high-contrast colors and wider labels in both themes.

title: Shared map controls
changes: Education and outreach maps now share layer controls, location selection and Fit/Restore tools.
Search filters education map markers; overlapping locations offer individual selections.

title: First Indianapolis outreach services
changes: Browse and search the first published outreach service.
Explore verified public service locations on the Indianapolis map.

title: Corrected live education evidence
changes: Reading First effect and mean panels now accept the typed decimal values returned by Geo.
Perry scenarios show their published perspective and horizon, and group rows name their published arms.

title: Live education comparisons and visual evidence
changes: Compare selected education initiatives and see their shared sources.
Filter the live evidence atlas by published categories, including unclassified entries.
Explore published observed means, compatible effects, and clearly labeled economic scenarios.

title: About, recent changes and new-feature notices
changes: Find a short introduction to Geo Companion in Preferences.
Browse dated release notes and version numbers.
A small dot highlights unseen releases until you open Recent changes.

title: Images, with a low-bandwidth option
changes: Content images load automatically.
Choose click-to-load images in Reading preferences to save data.

title: More ways to explore education
changes: Discover published datasets and filter results by their relationships.
Explore the original education Questions and their linked Answers.
Improved links, collection loading and handling of unavailable content.

title: Follow the research arguments
changes: Explore supporting and opposing arguments, with links to their sources.

title: Better on phones, light or dark
changes: The interface follows your system theme.
Improved mobile navigation, controls and chart readability.

title: A live evidence atlas
changes: Explore published education initiatives and follow their linked findings.

title: Explore together
changes: Invite another person to share selected views.
Optional community activity counts are available, with collection off by default.
